ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD with phone and address, placed on the home page since contact is noindex
ideas.why: Contact details exist only as plain text on a noindex page, so structured data on an indexable page would help machines identify the harbour office.

ideas.idea: Replace the price sentence with a table of mooring sizes and prices
ideas.why: The moorings description promises sizes and seasonal prices, but the page only says 'from £40 a night'.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page body to /moorings and /contact
ideas.why: The nav already links all pages, so links in the body add little.

ideas.idea: Show the FAQ questions and answers in visible page text, not only in JSON-LD
ideas.why: The FAQ content exists only in structured data, so the page text and the markup don't match.

ideas.idea: State the water taxi season (May to September) in the page text
ideas.why: The season is only in the FAQ JSON, and the page just says 'with a water taxi'.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it has little effect on a three-page site, and the report itself says to add it only if the dates are real.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags to the head
ideas.why: This is accurate for the layout but is standard boilerplate with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add a <main> element to the layout
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it's a standard semantic improvement that many sites could use, and it has little effect.

ideas.idea: Set Astro's `site` option in an astro.config
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, so no site origin is set, and that origin is needed to build absolute canonical URLs.

ideas.idea: Change the robots default to "index, follow" or drop the tag
ideas.why: This is the same fix as the known max-snippet problem, only restated.

ideas.idea: Fix the Article headline by removing the trailing comma and adding a geo.config.json policy if the crawler block is deliberate
ideas.why: This restates known problems or points to a tool config rather than adding anything specific to this site.

ideas.idea: Describe the home page's duplicate purpose ('Two pages overlap in purpose')
ideas.why: The note's heading claims the home and moorings pages overlap, but the files don't show that, and the advice it gives is only about internal links.
